conventions.axes: Rect local x, y, z coincide with global X, Y, Z
conventions.load: Pressure is negative Z. Deflection w is signed. Compared deflection is positive down.
conventions.moment: Positive sagging, in kN m/m. Coefficients are p*lx^2/M in this SSSS pilot.
conventions.shear: Qx and Qy are element transverse shears in kN/m. Reactions are nodal forces in kN.
